**Home Assistant release with the issue:**
<!--
- Frontend -> Developer tools -> Info
- Or use this command: hass --version
-->
0.97.2

**Last working Home Assistant release (if known):**


**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):**
HA on raspbian
<!--
Please provide details about your environment.
-->

**Component/platform:**
<!--
Please add the link to the documentation at https://www.home-assistant.io/components/ of the component/platform in question.
-->
https://www.home-assistant.io/components/netatmo/#camera

**Description of problem:**
I have configure netatmo with webhook. I use nabucasa for receive data to my home assistant. But netatmo component generate a new webhook id after every HA restart.


**Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` entries and (fill out even if it seems unimportant):**
```yaml
netatmo:
  api_key: ###
  secret_key: ###
  username: ###@gmail.com
  password: ###
  webhooks: true
```

**Traceback (if applicable):**

**Additional information:**
Error message on log:
```
ERROR (SyncWorker_8) [smart_home] The Netatmo API returned 400
```
comments: Same return code for me. Camera events are still firing (e.g. camera someone known) but all camera images are missing with lovelace error Entity not available: camera name. Applies to both welcome and presence cameras.

No idea why, but the cameras started working again. Error does not appear in the log for me now. No indication on the Netatmo sites (standard and developer) of any problems / changes. No other apps were affected.
The webhook ids are generated after each restart, which is a bug.

There hasn't been any activity on this issue recently. Due to the high number of incoming GitHub notifications, we have to clean some of the old issues, as many of them have already been resolved with the latest updates.
Please make sure to update to the latest Home Assistant version and check if that solves the issue. Let us know if that works for you by adding a comment 👍
This issue now has been marked as stale and will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.

review_comments: Is outdoor a special event that has multiple events embedded?

Yes, exactly that. 

https://dev.netatmo.com/apidocumentation/security#events

> Outdoor Subtypes
> For «Outdoor» events, an «event_list» array is available and provides more details about the event detected by the Smart Outdoor Camera. If several events are detected in the same video (e.g. a car is seen and people come out of it), there will only be one «Outdoor» event and its «eventlist» array will contain all of the events detected. Events are aggregated by video.
